name: IntegrateIT Metrics & Insights
notes: Samples any Control4 device variable into a bounded three-tier ledger (recent samples, hourly buckets, daily buckets), publishes min/max/average/trend insight variables and threshold events, and exports CSV or JSON for external charting. Local-calendar bucketing, an explicit privacy mode, and a capped project-backup footprint. MAC-locked IntegrateIT licensing.
